note: manual raster acquisitions, hashed like FIRMS_SOURCES.json; the raw manifest walks sources/ and data/cache/ only, so manual drop-ins carry their provenance here

spam_rice.tif.product: SPAM 2020 V2r2 global physical area, RICE, all technologies (RICE_A)
spam_rice.tif.source: Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/SWPENT (docs/DATA_ACQUISITION.md section 2 named the v1r0 release; the held file is the newer V2r2 of the same product line)
spam_rice.tif.units: hectares per 5-arc-min pixel; consumed as a relative weight surface

spam2020_V2r2_global_A_RICE_I.tif.licence: CC-BY-4.0 (the same Harvard Dataverse release as spam_rice.tif)
spam2020_V2r2_global_A_RICE_I.tif.status: consumed by the rice water-regime axis since rc26; the agriculture phase refuses to run without it (found by the rc40 validation package's reproduce.sh)

spam2020_V2r2_global_A_RICE_R.tif.licence: CC-BY-4.0 (the same Harvard Dataverse release as spam_rice.tif)
spam2020_V2r2_global_A_RICE_R.tif.status: consumed by the rice water-regime axis since rc26; the agriculture phase refuses to run without it (found by the rc40 validation package's reproduce.sh)

gcd_rice_2023.tif.product: GCD-Rice (Global Crop Dataset - Rice) Pakistan 2023, 30 m classified paddy extent, Int16 0/1
gcd_rice_2023.tif.source: ScienceDB doi:10.57760/sciencedb.21665 (Nature Scientific Data 2025; ~88.9% overall accuracy, 258k validation samples); file Classified-Rice-PAK-2023-v1.tif
gcd_rice_2023.tif.role: OWN-YEAR crosscheck instrument for the rice surface (pakemis_rice_geography_crosscheck.csv) and the priced ADM2 bracket - geography only, never magnitude
